_comment: Checks whose result depends on wall-clock time, CPU throttling or screenshot timing. They run in perf-report (non-blocking) and calibrate; the blocking gates skip them (LEMMA_PERF=off). Deterministic budgets (bytes, request counts, node counts, text-source contracts) stay blocking. Do not change any budget here.
